name: grok-build-gui
description: Codex-style desktop client for the Grok Build harness.
author: Grok Build GUI contributors

scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run icon && npx --yes electron-builder@26.8.1 --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && npm run icon && npx --yes electron-builder@26.8.1 --dir --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run icon && npx --yes electron-builder@26.8.1 --mac --publish never
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && npm run icon && npx --yes electron-builder@26.8.1 --linux --publish never
